GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 463.7 (22 Jan 46) GD
(SCAPIN - 645)
APO 500
22 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Request to Move Crude Oil from Funakawa to Yokohama.
1. Reference letter of General Liaison Office, Tokyo, file C.L.O. No. 169(2.3), dated 12 January 1946, subject: "Request for Permission to bring Crude Oil from Funakawa, Akita Prefecture, to the Yokohama Refinery of the Nippon Oil Co., Ltd."
2. Utilization of all facilities of the petroleum industry in the crude oil producing areas will permit processing of all indigenous crude oil production.
3. Request to transfer crude oil from Funakawa, Akita Prefecture to the Yokohama Refinery of the Nippon Oil Company is denied.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
